name: Hospital bed
summary: Adjustable hospital bed with a raised back, side rails, pillow and blanket on wheels. For ward and clinic scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the wheels rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the bed is about 900 px long and 500 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: raise = the back rises from flat to raised and back in a loop of 180 frames

params.name: flip
params.note: headboard on the right instead of the left

author: krakujs
